text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While looking for Narita Top Road,
who hadn't shown up for training—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Through pass connects! Feints the defender...!
GOAAAL! She's done iiiit--!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Did you see that just now!?
What an amazing finish!
Everyone's hard work and practice really—
choice_data_list: You've got to get your training in too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...!!!!!
I completely forgot about my own training...!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I am so, so very sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I made sure to firmly warn Narita Top Road to be careful next time...
